title: 003 - Pass Threshold
prompt: Fix the bug so the program print PASS when the score reaches the passing mark and prints exactly `PASS`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:
def pass_threshold(score):
    return "PASS" if score > 40 else "FAIL"
solutionCode:
def pass_threshold(score):
    return "PASS" if score >= 40 else "FAIL"
hint: The boundary score should still pass.
explanation: The broken comparison excludes the exact passing score. Using an inclusive comparison fixes the branch.
